title: ReferencePackage
description: Output of the Reference Image Engine (Cinematic Intelligence Layer, Phase 7). A reusable bundle of reference images for one subject (a character, an object, an environment) or for the project's style/pose vocabulary, ready to be handed to a conditioning-capable engine adapter. `prepared_for` flags are readiness markers, not working integrations - see IReferenceConditioningAdapter in packages/cinematic-intelligence-sdk for why ControlNet/IP-Adapter wiring is prepared, not implemented, in Phase 7.

subject_id.description: character_id/object_id/environment_id this package belongs to. Absent for kind=style or kind=pose, which are project-wide.

prepared_for.description: Which future conditioning mechanisms this package is structured to support. All default false in Phase 7 - no ControlNet/IP-Adapter model is actually invoked yet.
